in_hebrew.name: Glanville
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Will of the family
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Glanville הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A name of Old English origin, derived from the words 'clan' meaning 'family' and 'wyl' meaning 'will'. It symbolizes the strong connection and loyalty between family members and their shared desires.
